ev.q: The investigation focused on exposure sources and routes of transmission.

equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is present. Crew and passengers are occupational and travel exposure groups, and crew occupation is a route of exposure rather than SES.

notes: The report gives counts and proportions only, with no CIs, tests or models, so procedures and regression fields are empty. Passenger and crew counts and voyage-level transmission are set side by side with no computed contrast, so scale is null.
view_issues: The 3.4% passenger prevalence gives no denominator. The epidemic curve is not in the packet text, so voyage-level counts cannot be checked.
